l3.explanation: The audit form says audited payroll is 440,000 but the exposure holds 369,412. The script sets the exposure to the audited figure so premium recomputes upward.
l3.expected_effect: Expected: audited premium 2,244 against 2,040 billed, so the audit delta becomes +204 instead of -156. Not executed.

requirement.title: Validate audited basis against the audit form before final audit completes
requirement.problem: A final audit can complete with an exposure basis that differs from the audited payroll on the form, producing a wrong-direction premium.
requirement.root_cause: The auditor keyed the exposure basis by hand; nothing compares it with the audit form total.
evidence: Audit form payroll 440,000 vs exposure basis 369,412
acceptance_criteria: Final audit cannot complete if exposure basis differs from the form total by more than 0.5%
The direction test runs on every GL exposure at audit completion
test_scenarios: Basis equal to estimate, delta must be zero
Minimum premium applies, no false failure
requirement.risk: Low. Adds a validation at audit completion; existing completed audits are unaffected.

l2.conclusion: The audited basis stored on the GL exposure (369,412) does not match the audit form (440,000), so premium recomputed in the wrong direction. Needs an L3 data fix.
